fusions.name: Reared Height
fusions.desc: A blow with the rod that deals 30 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 5 tiles. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Mauling Rights
fusions.desc: A sweep that deals 8 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles of you (max 40%). Also costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Stand Over the Cubs
fusions.desc: Increases your maximum health by 20% for 10 seconds, and pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Den-Sworn Yearling
fusions.desc: A bonded bear yearling fights beside you, striking enemies within 4 tiles for 5 damage every 1.5 seconds. Anything it mauls moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.
